content: 仓库瘦身 95%：全站 12 张图片重制，12.91MB → 0.64MB。TypeAll 与 Verity 的 favicon 从 2.5MB / 1.9MB 压到 7KB / 6KB，SolHub 的 favicon 从 237KB 压到 2.2KB（全站 40+ 页面共用），项目图标与微信二维码同步重采样；文件名零改动，不需要动任何页面引用，打开速度明显变快。
content_en: Repo slimmed by 95%: 12 images rebuilt, 12.91MB down to 0.64MB. TypeAll and Verity favicons went from 2.5MB / 1.9MB to 7KB / 6KB, SolHub's favicon from 237KB to 2.2KB shared across 40+ pages, project icons and the WeChat QR resampled — same filenames, no markup changes, noticeably faster loads.

content: LunaSol 全新上线：AI 包装设计平台（solyoung-ai.github.io/LuanSol/）。只需回答「做什么包装、多大、叫什么、喜欢什么风格」，AI 就能自动完成盒型真实几何展开、三套创意方案、文字排版与原创插画，Three.js 3D 预览支持开盖/抽拉/贴曲面，印前检查用大白话提示出血、安全区、DPI 等问题，最后导出毫米级印刷 PDF、SVG、DXF 刀模与 300DPI 图片；不配 API Key 也能用内置引擎走完全流程。
content_en: LunaSol launches: an AI packaging design studio. Just answer what to pack, the size, the name and the style — AI handles real dieline geometry, three creative directions, typography and original artwork, with Three.js 3D preview (openable lids, sliding drawers, curved labels), plain-language prepress checks, and print-ready exports: mm-accurate PDF, SVG, DXF dielines and 300DPI images. Works fully offline with the built-in engine.

content: LunaSol 接入 CloudBase 国内站：注册登录与云端项目同步正式可用，AI 能力走 DeepSeek 后台代理、无需自己填 Key，老用户的模型配置已自动一次性迁移。
content_en: LunaSol is now connected to CloudBase (China): accounts and cloud project sync are live, AI runs through a DeepSeek backend proxy with no key setup, and existing model configs were migrated automatically.

content: 主站：全站配色去掉暖调、回归纯净白底，博客独立页还原为更简洁的文章列表样式。
content_en: Main site: removed the warm tint site-wide for a clean pure-white look, and the blog page is back to a simpler article list.

content: SolAPI：正式启用独立域名 solapi.solyoung.top。
content_en: SolAPI: production now runs on its own domain solapi.solyoung.top.

content: 主站：「思考」正式改名为「博客」，并拆出独立博客页 /blog/——顶部可按「创作 / AI / 记录」筛选，显示文章总数与开始写作的年份，支持中英切换，页尾引导去 X 追更；旧地址 /thoughts/ 依然可用，会自动跳到新页面。
content_en: Main site: Thoughts is now Blog, with a standalone page at /blog/ — filter by Making / AI / Notes, see the post count and the year writing began, switch between Chinese and English, and follow updates on X; old /thoughts/ links still work and redirect.

content: SolHub：每位创作者有了独立分享页——/u/<handle> 以及更短的 /@handle 都能直接打开，页面不带全站侧栏，分享出去就是一张干净的个人名片，浏览器标签也会显示创作者名字。
content_en: SolHub: every creator now has a standalone share page at /u/<handle>, also reachable via the shorter /@handle. It drops the site-wide sidebar, so a shared link reads like a clean personal card, and the browser tab shows the creator's name.

content: SolHub：上线全球创作者招募页 /join/（地球仪加代码元素的视觉，可一键生成招募分享卡），关于页与页脚都加了入口，创作者名录右栏也放了招募卡片；顺手修了窄屏下代码块把页面撑出横向滚动的问题。
content_en: SolHub: a global creator recruiting page launched at /join/ (globe and code visuals, one-click recruiter share card), linked from the About page, the footer and the Creators directory sidebar; also fixed the code block that pushed the page into horizontal scroll on narrow screens.

content: SolHub：提交产品就能自动点亮黄 V——邮箱已验证的用户上传自己的产品后自动获得认证，不必再等人工审核；「我」的页面名字旁也会显示；徽章换成锯齿印章加白勾的形状，更像认证而不是普通标签。
content_en: SolHub: submitting a product now lights up the gold V automatically — once your email is verified, uploading your product gets you verified without waiting for manual review; the badge also shows next to your name on the Me page, and the mark became a serrated seal with a white check so it reads as verification rather than a plain tag.

content: 主站：「关于我」抽屉整体换成白底黑字，之前对比度太低、字看不清；里面的 SolHub 卡片也改白底并做成整卡可点，点哪都能进 SolHub；关闭按钮缩小居中，去掉了占位的大标题，还加了中英切换。
content_en: Main site: the About drawer now uses dark text on white — the old version had too little contrast to read; the SolHub card inside is white too and fully clickable, the close button is smaller and centered, the oversized title is gone, and a Chinese/English toggle was added.

content: 主站：开屏左上角只保留「关于我」，与右上角菜单齐平；工牌上补了一句定位语「内容创作｜Ai实践｜个人项目」，首页自我介绍行也收成一句；开屏的姓名每个字母会跟着鼠标轻轻弹动。
content_en: Main site: the splash top-left now keeps only About, aligned with the menu on the right; the badge gained a positioning line (Content creation | AI in practice | Personal projects), the homepage intro shrank to a single line, and each letter of the name gently bounces with the cursor.

content: 主站：点导航栏的 SolYoung 可以回到开屏——不刷新页面，开屏原样复原，工牌物理重新启动；顶部导航里的「思考」也同步改成了「博客」。
content_en: Main site: clicking SolYoung in the nav returns you to the splash without a page reload, restoring it as-is and restarting the badge physics; the nav item Thoughts was renamed Blog as well.

content: 主站：社交入口新增 YouTube，排在 X 之后；站内三处定位文案统一成同一句话，不再各说各的。
content_en: Main site: YouTube joined the social links after X, and the three separate positioning lines across the site were unified into one consistent sentence.

content: SolHub：产品图标缺失时会用兜底样式显示，不再出现破图；产品目录的自动同步也加了防覆盖保护，手工整理的条目不会被同步任务冲掉。
content_en: SolHub: missing product icons now fall back to a placeholder instead of a broken image, and the catalog auto-sync is guarded against overwriting hand-curated entries.

content: 主站：新增开屏动画——悬挂工牌加巨型 Sol Young 姓名，工牌是一套真正的单摆物理（抓哪拽哪、可拽着转身、四个角各有不同手感、松手回弹），首页工牌也换成同款物理并加了悬停微风；开屏里还加了「快速了解」抽屉，一眼看完关于我
content_en: Main site: a new splash screen with a hanging ID badge and an oversized Sol Young wordmark. The badge runs a real pendulum simulation — grab it anywhere to drag, twist it by the corner, each corner has its own feel, and it swings back on release. The homepage badge now shares the same physics plus a hover breeze, and the splash adds a Quick intro drawer.

content: SolHub：「世界」改版为「创作者名录」——发帖功能整体下线，站点收敛成「产品 + 创作者」两个入口；名录显示头像、简介、站点与作品数，支持「全部 / 已认证 / 有作品」筛选与搜索，有作品和已认证的人排在前面
content_en: SolHub: World became a Creators directory — posting is retired and the site now has two clear entries: products and creators. Each card shows avatar, bio, site and product count, with All / Verified / Has products filters and search, ranking active and verified creators first.

content: SolHub：头像加载重构——头像改为可缓存的短链接并从主数据外置，/world 与 /search 接口响应体积缩小 50~100 倍，名录页打开明显变快；同时给创作者名录加分页与缓存，定时任务自动清理过期头像
content_en: SolHub: avatars reworked into cacheable short links stored outside the main records, shrinking /world and /search responses by 50–100×; the creators directory gained paging and caching, with a cron job cleaning stale avatar keys.

content: SolHub：手机端一批修复——输入框统一 16px 不再被 iOS 聚焦放大，搜索框右侧按钮不再被挤出屏幕，创作者名录的 @handle 换到第二行、名字不再被截断，登录请求也不再被浏览器跨域策略拦截
content_en: SolHub: a batch of mobile fixes — 16px inputs so iOS no longer zooms on focus, search buttons no longer pushed off-screen, creator handles moved to a second line so names stop truncating, and auth requests no longer blocked by cross-origin policy.

content: SolHub：数据每天自动快照到 kv_backup，误删、误改可以回滚找回
content_en: SolHub: automatic daily snapshots into kv_backup, so accidental deletions and edits can be rolled back.

content: SolHub：首页搜索改为跳转到产品页并当场展示搜索结果（?q= 关键词），不再随机直接进单个产品
content_en: SolHub: homepage search now lands on the products page with results shown inline (?q= keyword) instead of jumping straight into a single random product.

content: SolHub：首页副标题改成打字机逐字输出（带光标），速度调快约 2.5 倍，打开基本就读完了；SEO 全文与无 JS 环境仍保留完整文案
content_en: SolHub: the hero subtitle now types itself out with a cursor, about 2.5× faster than the first pass; the full text is still there for SEO and no-JS visitors.

content: SolHub：认证标识重做——用户认证统一为橙色线描圆徽（弧度修正为正圆），产品卡片改用绿色 Verified 徽章，人与产品一眼分得清
content_en: SolHub: verification badges redesigned — user verification is a single orange outline circle (now a true circle), while product cards use a green Verified badge so people and products read differently at a glance.

content: SolHub：站点评测问题集中修复——canonical 域名指向错误、sitemap 混入私有页、产品页 URL 注入、主页 404 死循环、社区与图标体积过大
content_en: SolHub: a sweep of site-audit fixes — wrong canonical domain, private pages leaking into the sitemap, URL injection on product pages, a homepage 404 loop, and oversized community assets and icons.

content: SolHub：页脚瘦身成一行「版权 + 关于」下拉（手机与桌面统一，隐私说明、提交、GitHub、核验入口收进菜单）；个人主页新增一键分享按钮，复制自己的公开主页链接
content_en: SolHub: the footer collapsed into one line — copyright plus an About dropdown, unified on mobile and desktop, with privacy, submit, GitHub and verification links tucked inside. Profiles also gained a one-tap share button that copies your public profile URL.

content: SolHub：登录服务整体迁移到国内节点（CloudBase 上海）——国内访问登录不再超时，个人主页卡死、跨境链路抖动导致的登录失败一并修复
content_en: SolHub: migrated the auth service to a China-region node (CloudBase Shanghai) — logins no longer time out from mainland China, and profile-page freezes and login failures from cross-border network jitter are fixed

content: SolHub：移动端登录适配——iOS Safari 等浏览器拦截跨站 Cookie 导致无法登录的问题，已改用令牌方式登录，移动端注册、登录、退出全链路修复
content_en: SolHub: mobile sign-in fixes — where iOS Safari and other browsers blocked cross-site cookies, sign-in now uses token-based auth; the full register / login / logout flow on mobile is repaired

content: SolHub：全站网络请求补齐超时与自动重试，弱网环境下页面加载与操作更稳定
content_en: SolHub: all network requests now have proper timeouts and automatic retries, so the site behaves more reliably on weak connections

content: SolHub：账号体系升级为邮箱验证码——注册、改邮箱、找回密码全都要收验证码（已打通阿里云 DirectMail 真实发信通道）；对外身份从邮箱改为用户名 @handle，邮箱则改为本人自主决定是否公开，主页上还会带「已验证」标识
content_en: SolHub: accounts now run on email verification codes — sign-up, email changes and password recovery all require one (real sending via Alibaba Cloud DirectMail). Your public identity is now a @handle instead of your email, and the email is only shown when you choose to, with a verified badge

content: SolHub：导航换成 X 式结构——桌面端左侧三档栏、手机端底部标签栏（发现 / 榜单 / 世界 / 我），下掉独立工具页；「世界」页新增 X 式搜人搜帖，注册开发者与全部帖子都能在服务端一次搜到
content_en: SolHub: navigation reworked X-style — a three-tier left rail on desktop and a bottom tab bar on mobile (Discover / Charts / World / Me), with the separate tools page retired. World gains X-style people and post search, querying all registered developers and posts server-side in one go

content: SolHub：上线管理后台（/guanli）——用户封禁与认证、帖子审核、产品认证可一站处理并带口令锁；同时新产品会自动播报到「世界」，每天还会推一条产品精选
content_en: SolHub: a new admin console (/guanli) for bans and verification, post moderation and product certification, protected by a passcode. New products are now auto-announced in World, with a daily featured-product digest

content: SolHub：个人主页可以展示「我拥有的产品」——认领产品目录里的作品或社区投稿都会出现在主页与「我的产品」，另新增联系方式栏；不存在的账号直接返回 404，不再生成空白主页
content_en: SolHub: profiles can now showcase the products you own — claimed catalog entries and community submissions both appear on your profile and in My Products, plus a new contact row. Nonexistent accounts now return 404 instead of a blank ghost profile

content: SolHub：一批稳定性与安全修复——登录/注册加入限流并做了 SSRF 防护；改密码不再把头像和简介一起覆盖掉；修掉「刚改完资料却显示旧值」的缓存问题，以及手机端世界页标签栏横向溢出、铅笔按钮被裁切
content_en: SolHub: a round of stability and security fixes — rate limiting on sign-in/sign-up and SSRF protection; changing your password no longer wipes your avatar and bio; fixed the stale-value cache after profile edits, plus mobile overflow in the World tab bar and a clipped compose button

content: OFX Atlas：站点重新定位为「剪映用户的 OFX 插件库」，一次性上新 12 款免费 / 开源 OFX 插件
content_en: OFX Atlas: repositioned as the OFX plugin library for CapCut users, launching 12 free and open-source OFX plugins at once

content: ClipText：转写后端切换到自建实例，默认走 base 模型，并适配免费实例的冷启动与真实转写耗时，出稿更快更稳
content_en: ClipText: transcription moved to a self-hosted backend, defaulting to the base model and tuned for cold starts and real-world latency on free instances — faster and steadier output

content: Media Parser：默认以纯 API 模式启动，修掉前端解析被 401 拦住的问题；语音转写统一输出简体中文并支持 tiny / base 模型切换，另加预热端点缩短首次等待
content_en: Media Parser: now boots in pure-API mode, fixing 401s that blocked front-end parsing; transcription outputs Simplified Chinese consistently, supports tiny/base model switching, and a warm-up endpoint shortens first-run waits

content: CamSim：校准页面数据、提升准确性，并重做首页与新手向导的交互体验
content_en: CamSim: tightened page data for accuracy and reworked the home page and onboarding wizard experience

content: SolHub：「世界」社区整体换装——采用白底画布主题配橙色签名，信息流改为 X 式通栏排版（1px 分隔线、最新/关注等宽标签、单行帖头、干净的 @用户名），发帖图标换成铅笔，深色主题同步更新，更像一个真正的社交平台
content_en: SolHub: World gets a full visual refresh — white-canvas theme with an orange signature, X-style edge-to-edge timeline (1px dividers, equal-width Latest/Following tabs, single-line post header, clean @handle), and a pencil compose icon; dark theme synced for a true social-platform feel

content: SolHub：官方账号 @solhub 正式入驻「世界」，会自动播报产品上新与更新日志，头像旁带官方认证徽章
content_en: SolHub: the official account @solhub has landed in World — it automatically posts product launches and changelogs, complete with a verified badge

content: ClipText：口播提取升级为三段式链路，绕开视频平台对服务器直接下载的拦截，提取成功率更高
content_en: ClipText: transcript extraction upgraded to a three-stage pipeline that bypasses video platforms' server-side download blocking, improving success rates

content: 主站：首屏头像卡变成了一枚悬挂工牌——V 形挂绳 + 金属扣 + 透明证卡套，鼠标悬停会随风轻摆、滚动时有惯性晃动，还修掉了吊绳每段末端的回勾，绳子不再一节一节
content_en: Homepage: the hero avatar card is now a hanging ID badge — V-shaped lanyard with a metal clip and transparent card sleeve; it sways in the breeze on hover and swings with inertia on scroll, and the kinks at the end of each lanyard segment are fixed

content: Media Parser：修复口播无法转写的问题——固定 Python 3.11 以正确安装 faster-whisper，并按域名匹配 Referer
content_en: Media Parser: fixed failed transcriptions — pinned Python 3.11 so faster-whisper installs correctly, with domain-matched Referer headers

content: SolHub：链接体验修复——填写的个人网址会自动补全 https:// 并跳转到真实站点，投稿产品改为新标签页打开，不再出现站内 404
content_en: SolHub: link fixes — user-entered website URLs now get https:// prepended and open the real site, and submitted product links open in a new tab instead of a 404 page

content: 主站：站点 favicon 换成个人头像，浏览器标签页更有辨识度
content_en: Homepage: the site favicon is now the personal avatar, easier to spot in browser tabs

content: SolHub：关于页文案重写，移除了 Roadmap 与已知限制章节；头部去掉冗余的投稿按钮；X Account Insight 的产品 Logo 换上新版设计
content_en: SolHub: About page copy rewritten (Roadmap and known-limits section removed), the redundant submit button dropped from the header, and the X Account Insight logo updated to the new design

content: SolHub：上线「世界」社交动态——可以发帖（可附链接）、点赞、评论、分享（复制直达链接）和关注他人，时间线分「最新」与「关注」两条流；站内导航新增「世界」入口，社区从「看作品」变成「聊作品」
content_en: SolHub: the World social feed is live — post (with an optional link), like, comment, share via a direct link, and follow other makers, with Latest and Following timelines; a new World entry sits in the site nav, turning the community from browsing products into talking about them

content: SolHub：「世界」页升级为 X 式布局——顶栏固定，左上角圆角「+」随手发帖，弹出的居中编辑器支持 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter 直接发布，右侧显示当前账号；点头像或 @用户名即可打开对方公开主页，含封面、简介、位置、网站、加入时间、关注/粉丝/产品数，可一键关注，并在「动态 / 产品」之间切换翻看其作品
content_en: SolHub: World redesigned in X style — a sticky top bar with a round + button for quick posting, a centered composer that publishes with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and your account chip on the right; tapping any avatar or @handle opens that maker's public profile with cover, bio, location, website, join date, following/follower/product counts, a follow button, and Posts / Products tabs

content: SolHub：修正站点 Logo 过大、撑满头部与页脚的问题，统一缩到 28px，顶部导航与页脚更清爽
content_en: SolHub: fixed the oversized logo that filled the header and footer — it now sits at 28px, making the top bar and footer noticeably cleaner

content: SolHub：登录体验重做——上线独立登录页（中英双语，支持登录后跳回原页面、密码随时可见切换），登录方式统一为邮箱账号并移除 GitHub 登录入口；登录服务同步迁移到自有域名，登录更稳定
content_en: SolHub: login rebuilt — a dedicated sign-in page (zh/en) with redirect-back after login and a show/hide password toggle; sign-in is now email-only and the GitHub login entry is gone; the auth service also moved to its own domain for a more stable login

content: SolHub：个人主页改版为 X 风格——顶部封面横幅、点击即可上传的大头像（自动裁剪压缩到 256px），昵称、简介、位置、个人网站都能自己改；页头头像新增下拉菜单，直达「我的账户 / 退出登录」
content_en: SolHub: profile page redesigned in X style — cover banner, click-to-upload large avatar (auto-cropped to 256px), and editable name, bio, location and website; the header avatar now opens a dropdown for My account / Log out

content: SolHub：投稿流程升级——投稿页新增登录引导横幅与收录标准自查，登录后可一键发布；社区投稿改为自动发布，提交后即刻上线，不再需要人工审核
content_en: SolHub: submission flow upgraded — the submit page now has a sign-in banner and a listing-criteria checklist, with one-click publishing once signed in; community submissions auto-publish and go live immediately without manual review

content: SolHub：修复社区内容中的中文乱码（后端读取数据统一按 UTF-8 解码），并修复小屏设备上登录弹窗邮箱输入框被裁切、无法填写的问题
content_en: SolHub: fixed garbled Chinese text in community content (backend now decodes data as UTF-8), and fixed the email field being clipped and unusable in the login dialog on short screens

content: SolHub：部署链路迁移过渡——后端与前端回退地址临时切换到 workers.dev，主域名访问异常时服务仍可正常使用，待 DNS 迁移完成后恢复自定义域名

Everything local in the browser (IndexedDB), keys stay local, zero server.

content: VIDEO LAB v55：修复 AI 生成链路三个真实 bug——①已配置 API 用户点击“生成分镜方案”无反应（aiassist 把 config() 当属性读，永远误报“尚未配置”）；②chatJSON 未导出导致请求中断；③错误分型参数顺序错误，API Key 无效等真实错误无法正确显示。现错误信息精确区分鉴权/地址/参数/限流/网络问题；生成→结构化校验→预览确认→合并/替换全链路本地验证通过。
content_en: VIDEO LAB v55: fixed three real bugs in the AI generation path — 1) the Generate button did nothing for users who had configured an API (aiassist read config() as a property, always mis-reporting 'not configured'); 2) chatJSON wasn't exported, breaking the request; 3) error classification args were swapped so real auth failures couldn't display. Now errors distinguish auth/endpoint/bad-request/rate-limit/network; the full chain generate -> validate -> preview -> merge/replace is verified locally.

content: VIDEO LAB v56：视觉重构为深色电影工作台——炭黑底色 + 深橙强调，达芬奇/Premiere 级创作软件质感。重构项目中心卡片（类型图标封面、Talking head 双语标签、镜头数徽标、hover 抬升）、分镜编辑器（镜头卡编号块与状态 chips、空状态插画引导 + 一键新建镜头）、顶部工具栏（类型+页面面包屑、保存状态徽标、撤销/重做/导出主次分明）；修复弹窗类名错位导致样式失效的问题；表格/设置/导出/拍摄板/提示条全页深色化，支持系统减少动效。
content_en: VIDEO LAB v56: dark cinema workstation — charcoal base + deep orange accent, DaVinci/Premiere-grade craft feel. Rebuilt project cards (type glyph cover, bilingual label, shot-count badge, hover lift), storyboard (shot number block & state chips, illustrated empty state with one-click New Shot), topbar (type+page breadcrumb, save-state badge, clear undo/redo/export hierarchy); fixed modal class mismatch that broke dialog styling; full-page dark theme for table/settings/export/production/toasts, respects reduced-motion.
